title: Moving Machine March
hook: Task before motion, boundary before view.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D road-vehicle storybook, toy-like vehicles, safe roads, clean silhouettes; visual identity: Moving Machine March

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing work machines from a safe boundary
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Moving Machine March a work-cycle song: arrive, position, dig/load/mix/compact/tow/clear, then leave; motion is subordinated to task and exclusion zones.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child watches machines from outside the work boundary and follows sequence rather than celebrating size or noise.
